get.description:
OAuth Protected Resource metadata endpoint.

This is the primary discovery endpoint that MCP clients (like mcp-remote) use
to discover OAuth requirements. It points clients to our Auth0 proxy as the
authorization server.

See: RFC 9728 (OAuth 2.0 Protected Resource Metadata)
